'''September 2001 Melbourne tournament (30 September)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Adam Amy's house, Melbourne, Australia on 30 September 2001. It is known from Rodney Lee's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3057">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-15-adz-house-melbourne-australia-30-09-01d3057/ adz-house-melbourne-australia-30-09-01], DeckTech (Rodney "DS Pro" Lee, 15 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-15-adz-house-melbourne-australia-30-09-01d3057/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Adam Amy's house, Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 8
